en.headline: 4 commits, 4 issue actions, 21 automated commits across 3 repos
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` made **4 own commits** across three repositories, plus **21 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, two commits updated the daily-report attribution logic to support aliases for non-GitHub-account emails and added a docs note on commit-attribution aliases. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, a single `chore(release): v1.15.5` commit tagged the release. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, an initial commit seeded the repo. On the issue side, `sogeisetsu` opened `openchamber/openchamber#4920` about the context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input, closing `openchamber/openchamber#4346` about `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`, and commented on `openchamber/openchamber#4111` about orphaned MCP child processes after deleting a multi-run. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied on `#4920` marking it `fix-ready` and confirming the numerator/denominator mismatch. `sogeisetsu` also joined the existing discussion `openchamber/openchamber#4821` on adding session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded for the day.

zh.headline: 4 次本人提交、4 项 issue 操作、21 次自动提交，覆盖 3 个仓库
zh.summary: 2026-10-15 当天，`sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库中完成 **4 次本人提交**，另有 **21 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**，全部位于 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次提交分别让日报的提交归属逻辑支持别名以兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交，并在文档中补充了提交归属别名的说明。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次 `chore(release): v1.15.5` 提交完成版本发布。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，一次 `chore: initial commit` 初始化了仓库。issue 方面，`sogeisetsu` 新开了 `openchamber/openchamber#4920`，指出上下文面板的占比条把整场会话的估算除以最后一条消息的输入，导致“其他”恒为 0%；关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber#4346`，该 issue 反映 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 在 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后仍通过；并在 `openchamber/openchamber#4111` 上留言，讨论删除多运行后遗留的 MCP 子进程导致 `git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 在 `#4920` 回复并标记为 `fix-ready`，确认分子分母口径不一致。`sogeisetsu` 还加入了 `openchamber/openchamber#4821` 的既有讨论，主题为在 Context Usage Panel 中加入会话聚合统计。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release。
